intro: The Tome of Divinity is a pivotal trial of faith and devotion for paladins in Stormwind. By proving mastery over the sacred Symbol of Life and restoring a fallen ally, an initiate earns the solemn blessing of resurrection from Duthorian Rall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'll take the script to the King's advisors after Duthorian's taken a look at them, but in the meantime, you should go speak to Duthorian now. He'll be wanting to pat you on the back for sure!
Thank you again, friend. I hope we meet again. You're surely an ally I'm proud to call friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done well this day, friend. You should take some pride in what you've accomplished.

Even more so, you should be proud of your abilities. Not everyone can use the power of the Symbol of Life. Calling upon the Light to bring back the dead means you're prepared for one of the adventurer's greatest honors: the power of resurrection.
You shall have the power to bring back fallen companions much like you did for Henze.
Be well, friend. The Light shines upon you and you should welcome it wholly.
